blurb: Guests can reserve bowling lanes that accommodate up to 6 bowlers with shoe rental included. Bumper bowling lanes are available for kids to keep balls out of gutters. The venue also offers a banquet hall for special occasions with catering and amenities.
extraNote: Entire party must arrive by 11:30pm for late night lane reservation check-in · If not here by 11:45pm or if party cancels, payment will be forfeited and lane released (late night) · Entire party must arrive by selected time for check-in for lane reservation · If not here within 15 minutes of start time or if party cancels, payment will be forfeited and lane released (lane reservation) · Lane will automatically shut down at end of reserved time regardless of start time · Lane will automatically shut down at end of reserved time regardless of start time (late night)
